mapper.select: SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE user_id = #{parentId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS id, u.name AS name, u.status AS status, w.id AS walletId FROM family_relations fr JOIN users u ON u.id = fr.child_id LEFT JOIN wallets w ON w.child_id = u.id WHERE fr.parent_id = #{parentId} AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY u.id
SELECT parent_id FROM family_relations WHERE child_id = #{childId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT status AS status, id AS requestId FROM family_relations WHERE child_id = #{childId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, password, name, phone, birth, user_type, role, status, invite_code ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{birth}, #{userType}, #{role}, #{status}, #{inviteCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'USER' AND user_type = 'PARENT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' )
SELECT status FROM users WHERE id = #{userId} AND role = 'USER' AND user_type = 'PARENT'
SELECT id AS userId, name AS name, email AS email, user_type AS type, invite_code AS inviteCode FROM users WHERE id = #{parentId} AND user_type = 'PARENT'

SELECT c.id AS userId, c.name AS name, c.email AS email, c.user_type AS type, p.name AS parentName, p.email AS parentEmail FROM users c LEFT JOIN family_relations fr ON fr.child_id = c.id AND fr.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN users p ON p.id = fr.parent_id WHERE c.id = #{childId} AND c.user_type = 'CHILD' ORDER BY fr.id LIMIT 1
